next.reason: 1985: "must not cause the simultaneous request for execution of more than one USE procedure."; 2023: "a USE statement specifying file-name-1 takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase". 1985 refuses any file-name USE that would request two procedures. 2023 bans only a repeated file-name and lets a file-name USE coexist with an open-mode USE, resolved by precedence.
